title: potentilla reflexa
intro: Potentilla reflexa, commonly known as Five-fingered Potentilla, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of the Himalayas. The health benefits of Potentilla reflexa include its potential to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Therapeutically, the plant is known for its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant actions. Bioactive constituents of Potentilla reflexa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
